summary.name: Pleroma
summary.one_liner: Pleroma is free, federated social networking server software compatible with the Fediverse, including Mastodon, Misskey and Pixelfed.
use_cases: running a private or public social network server
joining the Fediverse with a self-hosted instance
federating with Mastodon and Misskey users
choosing a frontend for a Pleroma server
summary.what_it_does: Pleroma is social networking server software that interoperates with other Fediverse software such as Misskey, Pixelfed and Mastodon. The page says it is free software, with development and issue tracking on the project's GitLab instance. It supports multiple frontends: Pleroma FE (the official customizable frontend), Soapbox (a simpler alternative), and Glitch-lily (a Pleroma-focused fork of Mastodon's multi-column frontend). The page links to an installation guide for setting up your own server and lists public instances that users can join.
notable: Interoperates with Mastodon, Misskey, Pixelfed and other ActivityPub/Fediverse software
Multiple selectable frontends: Pleroma FE, Soapbox, Glitch-lily
Written in Elixir and licensed AGPL-3.0 (per listing)
caveats: Public instances may have registrations closed or require an invite due to heavy sign-up demand and limited admin staffing
